if: input tax credit is claimed on a supply of goods or services or both
the registered person is NOT in possession of a tax invoice or debit note issued by a supplier registered under the Act, nor of such other tax paying document as may be prescribed
then: credit of that input tax is DENIED
note: Possession, not existence. A document that exists at the supplier is not possession by the recipient. The clause names three document types only: a tax invoice, a debit note, and such other tax paying documents as may be prescribed — which prescribed documents those are is UNKNOWN from the Act and lives in the Rules. The source is the CGST Act as updated 31-08-2021. UNKNOWN whether a later amendment has changed this provision; later amendments are not held locally.
